# 1. Configuration

Everything you might want to change lives here.

```{r config}
DGY3_ID      <- "DGY3,DGY3,0.00"
MIN_COUNTS   <- 3          # marker-positive if UMI count for that marker >= MIN_COUNTS (original code used "> 2")
MIN_FEATURES <- 200        # cell-level QC, matches CreateSeuratObject(min.features = 200)

MARKER <- "NATMX"          # ground-truth cell set: "NATMX", "KANMX", "BOTH", or "UNION"
METRIC <- "recall"         # "recall"    = of demuxlet-called DGY3 cells, what fraction carry the marker
                           #               (this is what the original code plotted)
                           # "precision" = of marker-positive cells, what fraction demuxlet calls DGY3
                           #               (this is the one that is literally "demuxlet accuracy",
                           #                i.e. marker = ground truth, demuxlet = classifier)

OUT_DIR  <- "../results"
OUT_FILE <- file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("Fig1B_demuxlet_accuracy_%s_%s.tiff", MARKER, METRIC))

samples <- tribble(
  ~Condition,     ~Replicate, ~demuxlet_path, ~matrix_dir,

  "YPD", 1,
  "/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/common_analysis_for_all/YPD.1/demuxlet/merged_demuxlet_output_YPD.tsv",
  "/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/common_analysis_for_all/YPD.1/alignment/output_of_alignment_YPD1_with_clean_gtf/run_count/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/",

  "YPD", 2,
  "/scratch/aa9679/SingleCell_cerevisiae/Gene_exp_analysis/yeast/yeast.2/data/merged_demuxlet_output_YPD_2.tsv",
  "/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/common_analysis_for_all/YPD.2/alignment/output_of_alignment_YPD2_with_clean_gtf/run_count/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/",

  "Fluconazole", 1,
  "/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/common_analysis_for_all/Flu.1/demuxlet/merged_demuxlet_output_flu_1.tsv",
  "/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/common_analysis_for_all/Flu.1/alignment/output_of_alignment_flu1_cust_ref/run_count/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/",

  "Fluconazole", 2,
  "/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/common_analysis_for_all/Flu.2/demuxlet/merged_demuxlet_output_flu_2.tsv",
  "/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/common_analysis_for_all/Flu.2/alignment/output_of_alignment_flu2_cust_ref/run_count/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/"
```

# 2. Functions

```{r functions}
load_demuxlet <- function(path) {
  d <- read.delim(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  num_cols <- c("BEST.LLK", "NUM.READS", "NUM.SNPS", "NEXT.LLK",
                "DIFF.LLK.BEST.NEXT", "BEST.POSTERIOR", "SNG.POSTERIOR",
                "SNG.BEST.LLK", "SNG.NEXT.LLK", "SNG.ONLY.POSTERIOR",
                "DBL.BEST.LLK", "DIFF.LLK.SNG.DBL")
  num_cols <- intersect(num_cols, colnames(d))
  d[num_cols] <- lapply(d[num_cols], as.numeric)
  na.omit(d)
}

# 10x barcodes carry a "-1" suffix; demuxlet output sometimes does not. Strip both.
strip_suffix <- function(x) sub("-\\d+$", "", x)

read_counts <- function(matrix_dir, min_features = MIN_FEATURES) {
  mat <- Read10X(data.dir = matrix_dir)
  if (is.list(mat)) mat <- mat[[1]]
  colnames(mat) <- strip_suffix(colnames(mat))
  mat[, Matrix::colSums(mat > 0) >= min_features, drop = FALSE]
}

# Marker-positive cells. grep can match >1 row (e.g. cassette split across features),
# so sum over all matching rows rather than assuming a single row.
marker_cells <- function(mat, pattern, min_counts = MIN_COUNTS) {
  idx <- grep(pattern, rownames(mat), ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (length(idx) == 0) stop("Marker '", pattern, "' not present in the reference.")
  colnames(mat)[Matrix::colSums(mat[idx, , drop = FALSE]) >= min_counts]
}

summarise_sample <- function(Condition, Replicate, demuxlet_path, matrix_dir) {

  dmx <- load_demuxlet(demuxlet_path)
  dmx$BARCODE <- strip_suffix(dmx$BARCODE)
  mat <- read_counts(matrix_dir)

  # IMPORTANT: restrict demuxlet calls to the QC-passing cells that are actually in the
  # count matrix. Otherwise the denominator includes droplets that were filtered out and
  # therefore can never be marker-positive, which artificially depresses the accuracy.
  shared <- intersect(dmx$BARCODE, colnames(mat))
  if (length(shared) / ncol(mat) < 0.5) {
    warning(Condition, " rep", Replicate,
            ": only ", length(shared), " of ", ncol(mat),
            " matrix barcodes found in demuxlet output — check barcode formatting.")
  }
  dmx <- dmx[dmx$BARCODE %in% shared, ]
  mat <- mat[, shared, drop = FALSE]

  dgy3 <- dmx$BARCODE[dmx$DROPLET.TYPE == "SNG" & dmx$BEST.GUESS == DGY3_ID]

  kan <- marker_cells(mat, "KANMX")
  nat <- marker_cells(mat, "NATMX")

  sets <- list(KANMX = kan,
               NATMX = nat,
               BOTH  = intersect(kan, nat),
               UNION = union(kan, nat))

  out <- data.frame(Condition = Condition,
                    Replicate = Replicate,
                    N_cells_QC = ncol(mat),
                    N_DGY3_demuxlet = length(dgy3),
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  for (s in names(sets)) {
    hit <- length(intersect(sets[[s]], dgy3))
    out[[paste0("N_", s)]]         <- length(sets[[s]])
    out[[paste0("Recall_", s)]]    <- 100 * hit / max(length(dgy3), 1)
    out[[paste0("Precision_", s)]] <- 100 * hit / max(length(sets[[s]]), 1)
  }

  # Dropout diagnostic: cells positive for one marker but not the other
  out$N_KANMX_exclusive <- length(setdiff(kan, nat))
  out$N_NATMX_exclusive <- length(setdiff(nat, kan))
  out
}
```

# 3. Compute

```{r compute}
results <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(samples)), function(i) {
  do.call(summarise_sample, as.list(samples[i, ]))
}))

results$Condition <- factor(results$Condition, levels = c("YPD", "Fluconazole"))
results <- arrange(results, Condition, Replicate)
knitr::kable(results, digits = 1)
```

```{r diagnostic}
# Does dropping KANMX cost anything? If N_KANMX_exclusive is a small fraction of
# N_UNION, then NATMX alone is effectively the same cell set as the union.
results %>%
  transmute(Condition, Replicate,
            N_UNION, N_NATMX, N_KANMX, N_BOTH,
            Pct_union_missed_by_NATMX = round(100 * N_KANMX_exclusive / N_UNION, 2)) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

# 4. Figure 1B

```{r figure}
metric_col <- paste0(ifelse(METRIC == "recall", "Recall_", "Precision_"), MARKER)

plot_df <- results %>%
  mutate(Accuracy = .data[[metric_col]])

summary_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(Accuracy),
            SD   = sd(Accuracy),
            n    = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(x_label = factor(paste0(Condition, "\n(n = ", n, ")"),
                          levels = paste0(levels(Condition), "\n(n = ", n, ")")))

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  left_join(select(summary_df, Condition, x_label), by = "Condition")

condition_colors <- c("YPD" = "#4E79A7", "Fluconazole" = "#E15759")

pub_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text        = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    axis.title       = element_text(color = "black", size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.line        = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.position  = "none",
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

fig1b <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = x_label, y = Mean, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.55, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(Mean - SD, 0), ymax = Mean + SD),
                width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_point(data = plot_df, aes(x = x_label, y = Accuracy),
             shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5,
             fill = "white", color = "black",
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.07, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Mean), y = Mean + SD),
            vjust = -0.8, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 110), expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Demuxlet accuracy (%)",
       title = "DGY3 recovery (NATMX barcode)") +
  pub_theme

fig1b
```

```{r save}
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(OUT_FILE, fig1b, width = 3.4, height = 4.0, units = "in",
       dpi = 300, device = "tiff", compression = "lzw")

write.csv(results, file.path(OUT_DIR, "Fig1B_source_data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
